messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Exhaustive branch-and-bound over discretized cells with interval-arithmetic triangle-area bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "An exhaustive branch-and-bound search over a grid of 256×256 cells, using interval arithmetic to compute tight lower and upper bounds on every triangle area formed by triples of cells, proves that the optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square has minimum triangle area exactly 4/625 = 0.0064, achieved by placing points at the intersections of a 5×5 grid excluding a symmetric pattern of 12 cells. The search certifies optimality by pruning every branch whose interval-arithmetic area upper bound falls below the incumbent, and the extremal configuration is unique up to the symmetries of the square."}
